q: What carbon figure should a Philippine rebar mill use for the billets it imports?
title: Philippine rebar mill: imported billets
short: Ask the billet supplier for CO2 per tonne for the route and year; billets from blast furnace plants carry much more than billets from scrap based electric furnaces. Multiply by tonnes imported as Scope 3, Category 1. Your reheating furnace fuel is Scope 1 and mill power is Scope 2.
audience: Rebar and wire rod rolling mills in Batangas, Bulacan and Cebu using imported billets

ul: Blast furnace and converter billets: high per tonne.
Scrap based electric furnace billets: much lower.
DRI based electric furnace billets: in between, depending on fuel.

p: Reheating fuel and rolling power are usually small next to the billet. Getting the billet figure right matters most.
Bills of lading with tonnes and supplier, the supplier's figure, and your fuel and power bills.
